units.literal: Zhao Yanshen, in private at the Office for Imperial Progress, secretly asked Wenzong, "Wu the bandit swells and has come to this. I have long blocked the worthy and am torn by worry and fear. In today's situation, what plan will do?

units.zh: 袁泌字文洋，左光祿大夫敬之弟也。
units.en: Yuan Bi, styled Wenyang, was the younger brother of left grand master of the golden sigil Jing.
units.literal: Yuan Bi, styled Wenyang, was the younger brother of Left Grand Master of the Golden Sigil Jing.

units.zh: [7]其子述泌遺意，表請之，朝廷不許，贈金紫光祿大夫，諡曰質。
units.en: [7] His son reported Bi's dying wish and memorialized to request it, but the court refused. Bi was posthumously made grand master with gold seal and purple ribbon and given the posthumous title Zhi.
units.literal: [7] His son reported Bi's dying wish and submitted a memorial requesting it, but the court did not allow it; Bi was posthumously presented as grand master with gold seal and purple ribbon and given the title Zhi.

units.zh: 高宗入輔，以泌為雲旗將軍、司徒左長史。
units.en: When Emperor Xuan entered as regent, he made Bi cloud-banner general and left chief clerk to the minister of education.
units.literal: When Emperor Xuan entered as regent, he made Bi cloud-banner general and left chief clerk to the minister of education.

units.zh: 貞陽侯僭位，以泌為侍中，奉使於齊。
units.en: When the Marquis of Zhenyang seized the throne, Bi was made palace attendant and sent as envoy to Qi.
units.literal: When the Marquis of Zhenyang usurped the throne, Bi was made Palace Attendant and sent on embassy to Qi.

units.zh: 釋褐員外散騎侍郎，歷諸王府佐。
units.en: He left the commoner's dress for supernumerary regular attendant and served as aide in several princely households.
units.literal: He doffed the commoner's garb as Supernumerary Regular Attendant and served as aide in several princely establishments.

units.zh: 是時泌兄君正為吳郡太守，梁簡文板泌為東宮領直，令往吳中召募士卒。
units.en: At that time his elder brother Junzheng was administrator of Wu commandery. Emperor Jianwen of Liang commissioned Bi as leader of direct service in the eastern palace and sent him to Wu to raise troops.
units.literal: At that time Bi's elder brother Junzheng was Administrator of Wu commandery; Emperor Jianwen of Liang commissioned Bi as Leader of Direct Service in the Eastern Palace and ordered him to Wu to recruit soldiers.

units.zh: 尋授寧遠始興王府法曹參軍，轉諮議參軍，除通直散騎常侍，兼侍中，領豫州大中正。
units.en: Soon he was appointed legal aide in the household of the Prince of Shixing, general who pacifies the distant. He was then transferred to advisory aide, made regular attendant of direct communication, concurrently palace attendant, and put in charge of the grand rectifier of Yuzhou.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed legal aide in the household of the Prince of Shixing, general who pacifies the distant, transferred to advisory aide, made regular attendant of direct communication, concurrently palace attendant, and put in charge of the grand rectifier of Yuzhou.

units.zh: 臨終戒其子蔓華曰：「吾於朝廷素無功績，瞑目之後，斂手足旋葬，無得輒受贈諡。」
units.en: As death approached, he warned his son Manhua, "I have never had merit at court. After I close my eyes, bind my hands and feet and bury me at once. Do not rashly accept posthumous offices or titles."
units.literal: As he neared death, he warned his son Manhua, "I have never had merit at court. After I close my eyes, bind my hands and feet and bury me at once. You must not rashly accept posthumous offices or titles."

units.zh: 清正有幹局，容體魁岸，志行脩謹。
units.en: He was upright and capable, tall in bearing, and scrupulous in conduct.
units.literal: Upright and pure, with administrative capacity, of imposing stature, and careful in conduct.

units.zh: 及景圍臺城，泌率所領赴援。
units.en: When Jing besieged the Terrace City, Bi led his command to the relief.
units.literal: When Jing besieged the Terrace City, Bi led the men under his command to the relief.

units.zh: 範卒，泌乃降景。
units.en: When Fan died, Bi surrendered to Jing.
units.literal: When Fan died, Bi thereupon surrendered to Jing.

units.zh: 景平，王僧辯表泌為富春太守，兼丹陽尹。
units.en: After Jing was suppressed, Wang Sengbian recommended Bi as administrator of Fuchun and intendant of Danyang.
units.literal: When Jing was pacified, Wang Sengbian memorialized that Bi be made Administrator of Fuchun, concurrently Intendant of Danyang.

units.zh: 及莊僭立，[4]以泌為侍中、丞相長史。
units.en: When Zhuang declared himself emperor, [4] Bi was made palace attendant and chief clerk to the chancellor.
units.literal: When Zhuang usurped the throne, Bi was made Palace Attendant and Chief Clerk to the Chancellor.

units.zh: 光大元年卒，年五十八。
units.en: He died in Guangda year 1 (567), aged fifty-eight.
units.literal: He died in Guangda year 1, aged fifty-eight.

units.zh: 侯景之亂，泌欲求為將。
units.en: During Hou Jing's rebellion Bi sought a military command.
units.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion Bi wished to become a general.

units.zh: 聘于周，使還，授散騎常侍，御史中丞，其中正如故。
units.en: He was sent on a mission to Zhou. On his return he was appointed scattered-cavalry regular attendant and censor-in-chief, with his rectifier post unchanged.
units.literal: He was sent on a mission to Zhou; when he returned, he was appointed scattered-cavalry regular attendant and censor-in-chief, with his rectifier post as before.

units.zh: 京城陷，退保東陽，景使兵追之，乃自會稽東嶺出湓城，依于鄱陽嗣王蕭範。
units.en: When the capital fell he fell back to Dongyang. Jing sent troops after him; Bi slipped out by the eastern pass of Kuaiji through Tangcheng and joined the heir of Poyang, Xiao Fan.
units.literal: When the capital fell he withdrew to hold Dongyang; Jing sent troops in pursuit, and he went out by the eastern pass of Kuaiji through Tangcheng and attached himself to the Heir of Poyang, Xiao Fan.

units.zh: 高祖受禪，王琳據有上流，泌自齊從梁永嘉王蕭莊達琳所。
units.en: When the Founder took the throne, Wang Lin held the upper Yangzi. Bi came from Qi with Liang's Prince of Yongjia, Xiao Zhuang, to join Lin.
units.literal: When the Founder received the abdication, Wang Lin held the upper reaches; Bi came from Qi with Liang's Prince of Yongjia, Xiao Zhuang, to Lin's camp.

units.zh: 譬若以周、邵為丞相，孔丘為御史大夫，太公為將軍，畢公高拾遺於後，弁嚴子為衛尉，皋陶為大理，後稷為司農，伊尹為少府，子贛使外國，顏、閔為博士，子夏為太常，益為右扶風，季路為執金吾，契為鴻臚，龍逢為宗正，伯夷為京兆，管仲為馮翊，魯般為將作，仲山甫為光祿，申伯為太僕，延陵季子為水衡，百里奚為典屬國，柳下惠為大長秋，史魚為司直，蘧伯玉為太傅，孔父為詹事，孫叔敖為諸侯相，子產為郡守，王慶忌為期門，夏育為鼎官，羿為旄頭，宋萬為式道候。」
units.en: Imagine the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao as your chancellors; Confucius as chief censor; the Grand Duke as commander; Duke Bi Gao as court remonstrant; Bian Zhuangzi as captain of the guard; Gao Yao as chief judge; Hou Ji as minister of agriculture; Yi Yin as palace treasurer; Zigong as foreign envoy; Yan Hui and Min Ziqian as court scholars; Zixia as master of rites; Yi as western capital intendant; Zilu as capital commandant; Xie as master of guest ceremonies; Guan Longpeng as keeper of the imperial genealogy; the minister Boyi as metropolitan governor; Guan Zhong as northern capital intendant; Lu Ban as chief engineer; Zhong Shanfu as palace chamberlain; the Earl of Shen as master of the horse; Prince Jizi of Yanling as keeper of parks and waters; Baili Xi as commissioner for dependent peoples; Liuxia Hui as chamberlain to the empress; Shi Yu as censor of conduct; Qu Boyu as grand tutor; Kong Fu as supervisor of the heir apparent's household; Sunshu Ao as chancellor to the feudal lords; Zichan as commandery governor; Prince Qingji as a palace gate guard; Xia Yu as cauldron officer; Yi the Archer as vanguard officer; and Song Wan as road-clearing scout."
units.literal: It is as if you had made the Duke of Zhou and the Duke of Shao your chancellors; Confucius your Censor-in-Chief; the Grand Duke your general; Duke Bi Gao your remonstrant at the rear; Bian Zhuangzi your Commandant of the Guards; Gao Yao your Chief Justice; Hou Ji your Minister of Agriculture; Yi Yin your Privy Treasurer; Zigong your envoy abroad; Yan Hui and Min Ziqian your Erudites; Zixia your Minister of Ceremonies; Yi your western capital intendant; Zilu your Capital Commandant; Xie your Grand Herald; Guan Longpeng your Director of the Imperial Clan; the minister Boyi your Metropolitan Governor; Guan Zhong your northern capital intendant; Lu Ban your Superintendent of Works; Zhong Shanfu your Chamberlain for Attendants; the Earl of Shen your Grand Coachman; Prince Jizi of Yanling your Superintendent of Waters and Parks; Baili Xi your Director of Dependent States; Liuxia Hui your Chamberlain for the Empress; Shi Yu your Rectifier; Qu Boyu your Grand Tutor; Kong Fu your supervisor of the heir apparent's household; Sunshu Ao your chancellor to the feudal lords; Zichan your commandery governor; Prince Qingji your Palace Gate Guard; Xia Yu your Cauldron Officer; Yi the Archer your Vanguard Officer; and Song Wan your road-clearing scout."

units.zh: 及侯景西上，鐵虎從僧辯克任約，獲宋子仙，每戰皆有功。
units.en: When Hou Jing marched west, Tiehu followed Sengbian against Ren Yue, took Song Zixian prisoner, and earned merit in every fight.
units.literal: When Hou Jing marched west, Tiehu followed Sengbian in defeating Ren Yue, captured Song Zixian, and in every battle had merit.

units.zh: 是月，王琳爲陳所敗，蕭莊自拔至和州。
units.en: That month Wang Lin was defeated by Chen forces, and Xiao Zhuang fled on his own to Hezhou.
units.literal: That month Wang Lin was defeated by Chen; Xiao Zhuang escaped on his own to Hezhou.

units.zh: 是時梁太尉王僧辯、司空陳霸先在建鄴，推晉安王方智為丞相。
units.en: At that time Liang grand commandant Wang Sengbian and minister of works Chen Baxian were at Jiankang; they installed Prince of Jin'an Fang Zhi as chancellor.
units.literal: At that time Liang Grand Commandant Wang Sengbian and Minister of Works Chen Baxian were at Jiankang; they installed Prince of Jin'an Fang Zhi as chancellor.

units.zh: 以方智為太子，授王僧辯大司馬。
units.en: Fang Zhi was made heir apparent; Wang Sengbian was appointed grand marshal.
units.literal: Fang Zhi was made heir apparent; Wang Sengbian was appointed grand marshal.

units.zh: 天保六年，梁元為西魏所滅，顯祖詔立明為梁主，前所獲梁將湛海珍等皆聽從明歸，令上黨王渙率衆以送。
units.en: In the sixth year of Tianbao, when Emperor Yuan of Liang was destroyed by Western Wei, Gao Yang issued an edict installing Ming as Liang ruler; Liang generals previously captured, such as Zhan Haizhen, were all allowed to follow Ming home, and Prince of Shangdang Huan was ordered to lead troops to escort them.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tianbao, when Emperor Yuan of Liang was destroyed by Western Wei, Gao Yang issued an edict installing Ming as Liang ruler; Liang generals previously captured, such as Zhan Haizhen, were all allowed to follow Ming home, and Prince of Shangdang Huan was ordered to lead troops to escort them.

units.zh: 冬，霸先襲殺僧辯，復立方智，以明為太傅、建安王。
units.en: In winter Baxian attacked and killed Sengbian, restored Fang Zhi, and made Ming grand tutor and Prince of Jian'an.
units.literal: In winter Baxian attacked and killed Sengbian, restored Fang Zhi, and made Ming grand tutor and Prince of Jian'an.

units.zh: 顯祖賜僧辯、霸先璽書，僧辯未奉詔。
units.en: Gao Yang bestowed sealed letters on Sengbian and Baxian; Sengbian did not obey the edict.
units.literal: Gao Yang bestowed sealed letters on Sengbian and Baxian; Sengbian did not obey the edict.

units.zh: 上黨王進軍，明又與僧辯書，往復再三，陳禍福，僧辯初不納。
units.en: Prince of Shangdang advanced his army; Ming also exchanged letters with Sengbian back and forth several times, setting out fortune and calamity, but at first Sengbian would not accept him.
units.literal: Prince of Shangdang advanced his army; Ming also exchanged letters with Sengbian back and forth several times, setting out fortune and calamity, but at first Sengbian would not accept him.

units.zh: 旣而上黨王破東關，斬裴之橫，江表危懼，僧辯乃啟上黨求納明，遣舟艦迎接。
units.en: Then Prince of Shangdang broke Dongguan and beheaded Pei Zhiheng; the lands south of the Yangtze were gripped with fear, and Sengbian then memorialized Prince of Shangdang asking to admit Ming and sent warships to receive him.
units.literal: Then Prince of Shangdang broke Dongguan and beheaded Pei Zhiheng; the lands south of the Yangtze were gripped with fear, and Sengbian then memorialized Prince of Shangdang asking to admit Ming and sent warships to receive him.

units.zh: 霸先奉表朝廷，云僧辯陰謀篡逆，故誅之。
units.en: Baxian submitted a memorial to the court saying Sengbian had plotted treason in secret and was therefore executed.
units.literal: Baxian submitted a memorial to the court saying Sengbian had plotted treason in secret and was therefore executed.

units.zh: 庚申，詔以故太師尉景、故太師竇泰、故太師太原王婁昭、故太宰章武王厙狄幹、故太尉段榮、故太師万俟普、故司徒蔡儁、故太師高乾、故司徒莫多婁貸文、故太保劉貴、故太保封祖裔、故廣州刺史王懷十二人配饗太祖廟庭，故太師清河王岳、故太宰安德王韓軌、故太宰扶風王可朱渾道元、故太師高昂、故大司馬劉豐、故太師万俟受洛干、故太尉慕容紹宗七人配饗世宗廟庭，故太尉河東王潘相樂、故司空薛脩義、故太傅破六韓常三人配饗顯祖廟庭。
units.en: On the gengshen day, an edict ordered twelve deceased ministers to receive associated sacrifice in the Founding Emperor's temple, including Wei Jing, Dou Tai, Lou Zhao, She Digan, Duan Rong, Wan Sipo, Cai Jun, Gao Gan, Moduo Lou Daiwen, Liu Gui, Feng Zuyi, and Wang Huai; seven others in Emperor Wenxiang's temple, including Princes Yue, Han Gui, and Kezhuhun Daoyuan, Liu Feng, Wan Sipo Shouluogan, and Murong Shaozong; and three more in Emperor Wenxuan's temple—Pan Xiangle, Xue Xiuyi, and Poliuhan Chang.
units.literal: On the gengshen day, an edict ordered that the late Grand Preceptor Wei Jing, Grand Preceptor Dou Tai, Grand Preceptor Prince of Taiyuan Lou Zhao, Grand Minister Prince of Zhangwu She Digan, Grand Commander Duan Rong, Grand Preceptor Wan Sipo, Minister of Education Cai Jun, Grand Preceptor Gao Gan, Minister of Education Moduo Lou Daiwen, Grand Guardian Liu Gui, Grand Guardian Feng Zuyi, and Inspector of Guang Province Wang Huai—twelve men in all—be given associated sacrifice in the Founding Emperor's temple court; that Grand Preceptor Prince of Qinghe Yue, Grand Minister Prince of Ande Han Gui, Grand Minister Prince of Fufeng Kezhuhun Daoyuan, Grand Preceptor Gao Ao, Grand Marshal Liu Feng, Grand Preceptor Wan Sipo Shouluogan, and Grand Commander Murong Shaozong—seven men—be given associated sacrifice in Emperor Wenxiang's temple court; and that Grand Commander Prince of Hedong Pan Xiangle, Minister of Works Xue Xiuyi, and Grand Tutor Poliuhan Chang—three men—be given associated sacrifice in Emperor Wenxuan's temple court.

units.zh: 及高祖討王僧辯，令世祖還長城招聚兵眾，以備杜龕，頻使昭達往京口，稟承計畫。
units.en: When the Founder moved against Wang Sengbian he sent Emperor Wen back to Changcheng to raise men and stores against Du Kan and repeatedly sent Zhaoda to Jingkou to carry his orders.
units.literal: When the Founder campaigned against Wang Sengbian he ordered Emperor Wen to return to Changcheng to gather troops and supplies against Du Kan, and repeatedly sent Zhaoda to Jingkou to receive and carry out plans.

units.zh: 及杜泰退走，因從世祖東進，軍吳興，以討杜龕。
units.en: When Du Tai withdrew, he followed Emperor Wen east. The army camped at Wuxing to attack Du Kan.
units.literal: When Du Tai withdrew, he followed Emperor Wen eastward; the army was at Wuxing to campaign against Du Kan.

units.zh: 龕平，又從世祖東討張彪於會稽，克之。
units.en: When Kan fell he marched east again with Emperor Wen against Zhang Biao at Kuaiji and took the city.
units.literal: When Kan was pacified he again followed Emperor Wen east to campaign against Zhang Biao at Kuaiji and captured it.

units.zh: 僧辯誅後，龕遣其將杜泰來攻長城，世祖拒之，命昭達總知城內兵事。
units.en: After Sengbian was killed, Kan sent Du Tai against Changcheng. Emperor Wen held the city and put Zhaoda in charge of the garrison.
units.literal: After Sengbian was executed Kan sent his general Du Tai to attack Changcheng; Emperor Wen resisted him and ordered Zhaoda to take overall charge of troops within the city.
